questions.payment: Which payment methods do you accept?
questions.payment_text: We accept all major credit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.
questions.replacement: When should I replace my tires?
questions.replacement_text: Legally the minimum tread depth is 1.6mm, but for safety we recommend replacement at 3mm (summer) or 4mm (winter). Also check for cracks, bulges, or aging (older than 6-10 years).
questions.seasonal: What is the difference between summer, winter, and all-season tires?
questions.seasonal_text:
• Summer tires: Optimal above 7°C, harder compound for grip on dry/wet roads.
• Winter tires: Essential below 7°C, deeper tread and softer rubber for grip on snow/ice.
• All-season tires: A compromise for moderate climates, suitable year-round but performance is less than specialized tires in extremes.
questions.balancing_alignment: What is the difference between balancing and alignment?
questions.balancing_alignment_text:
• Balancing: Ensures the wheel rolls smoothly without vibration at speed (done with every tire change).
• Alignment: Ensures wheels are straight relative to the car for driving straight and even tire wear (needed if pulling to one side or after suspension repair).
questions.tpms: What is TPMS and can you service it?
questions.tpms_text: TPMS (Tire Pressure Monitoring System) monitors your tire pressure. We can install, reset, and replace TPMS sensors when batteries are depleted.
questions.repair: Can you repair a flat tire?
questions.repair_text: Yes, often. If the puncture is in the tread and not too large, we use a professional plug/patch. Sidewall damage often cannot be safely repaired.
questions.recycling: What happens to my old tires?
questions.recycling_text: We dispose of your old tires in an environmentally friendly way through certified recycling partners (Recytyre), so the rubber can be reused.

eligibility.content: This return policy applies to tires purchased online through our website. Tires purchased and installed in-store are not eligible for return.

timeframe.content: You have 14 days from the date of delivery to request a return, in accordance with Belgian and EU consumer protection law.

conditions.title: Return Conditions
conditions.content: To be eligible for a return, the tires must meet the following conditions:
conditions.unused: The tires must be unused and not driven on
conditions.unmounted: The tires must not have been mounted on a rim
conditions.originalPackaging: The tires must be in their original packaging
conditions.withReceipt: You must provide your order confirmation or receipt

refunds.content: Once we receive and inspect the returned tires, we will process your refund within 14 days.
refunds.method: The refund will be issued to the same payment method used for the original purchase.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.content: The following items cannot be returned:
exceptions.mounted: Tires that have been mounted on a rim
exceptions.used: Tires that show signs of use or road wear
exceptions.customOrders: Custom-ordered tires or special sizes ordered specifically for you
exceptions.damaged: Tires damaged due to improper storage or handling by the customer
